beats.headline: We'll be there, Carl
beats.text: Okay so, me and Firas are in a bar in Hump Town, and the lady on my lap is doing Jessica Rabbit, which, much better than the slave Leia. Then Carl walks in. I told Firas that was Carl. He wants everybody at the Toe after the recap. The Toe, man. It's a camel town. Get it? Firas does not get it. I ask if he's gonna blow us up, and the cat jumps on the table, spills the vodka and calls us chuckleheads. We'll be there, Carl.

beats.headline: The Tiddy Twister
beats.text: Okay so, the van. My mom's Chevy Astro, top cut off, the Tiddy Twister, a hundred thousand likes. Five in the morning, driving back from Jojo's on I-95, road goes all jacked, glowing stairwell right there, slid right in. Broke the axle. Got a spell for being the first to drive a van into the dungeon: Cloud of Exhaust, level eleven. Me and Firas spray and run. Then the eagle hands us white potions with no description and I puke for like five minutes. Notification says I can't drink anymore. Not cool, man. It's all I got left.

beats.headline: Two levels off a camel
beats.text: Okay so, the frog plan. Firas jumps us up to a balcony, and we walk down the stairs like we work there, calm purpose, whatever that means. Carl throws a sparkler through the cat's hole, I cast the cloud, and two camels go down, only they're not camels, they're these faceless guys with glowing heads. Carl kills one. Then he tells me and Firas to hit the other one in the head. It wakes up. We hit it a bunch, the cat finishes it. I went up two levels. Firas is 24. Now we're holding a door.

beats.headline: The Twister, and a photo
beats.text: Okay so, the AI gave Carl pictures of a bunch of alien moms, and one of them is this angry bald elf lady with blue eyes and she's the hottest thing I've ever seen, so I ask Juice Box for another session where she looks like her. Carl rips the photo out of my hands. Also the house has a name now. The Twister. I wanted Tiddy Twister II, after my van, which was my mom's van until I chopped the top off, but Firas says we're trying to be more mature. And Katia wouldn't let us.

beats.headline: Riding the Twister through the storm
beats.text: Okay so, Carl wants me and Firas out in the storm, in the flying house, keeping behind the dog's heads while Donut heals it. In the storm, man. The balloon is slamming back and forth. Whiplash. It's like riding a bull, and Firas says he did that once and fell off. Then he sees half the bowl break away, the side with the Bactrian village, just gone. The net's shot, so we have to land to fix it. No choice. I'm up on the roof telling Carl this thing's going to fall out of the sky if we don't.

beats.headline: Juice Box told you, huh
beats.text: Okay so, Donut sits down next to me and wants to know when the nuptials are. She'll be maid of honor, Mongo's the ring bearer, Carl can officiate because he found religion, and she'll sing. For a fee, obviously. My face is on fire, man. Juice Box told you, huh? She didn't have to, Donut says. Love makes a person glow. Also, I'm level thirty-five and I'm an Extermination Professional now instead of a Pest Exterminator, which gets me half a percent insta-kill on mobs my level or lower. That's it. That's the upgrade.

beats.headline: Circled until the pencil broke
beats.text: Okay so, the Dream have one name on their list. One. The very last one, which is mine. Their dead guy circled it so many times the pencil went through the paper, and then drew my face at the bottom with a big X over it. Carl puts the whole map in the group chat and tells Katia she has to watch my back. Man, all I did was grab a photo of their boss's mom and ask Juice Box to turn into her. It's not my fault they can't take a joke.

beats.headline: The Voltron move
beats.text: Okay so, I came up with a move on my own. I throw armor at Katia and it equips itself the second it lands, if she has the slot open. Now picture her huge, no breastplate, and we drop a giant one on her from the Twister, and she gets even bigger, then a bigger helmet. Like Voltron. Sort of. Britney says if it misses, Katia gets crushed. It's a work in progress, man. Carl says it's a good idea. Just be careful.

beats.headline: Tent the House
beats.text: Okay so, my Extermination Professional class has this thing called Tent the House. I take a potion and spread it over, like, a whole area, and from the deck of the Twister even wider. Once every six hours, so three goes before dark if we start now. Mordecai says maximum distance, man. Also Mongo has a girlfriend and she's pink, and she's a lot bigger than him. You go, buddy. I grab the last two jugs on my way out.

beats.headline: Kill credit, Louis Santiago 2
beats.text: We tent the house from the Twister and the creeper goes down, and the system gives the kill to Louis Santiago 2, which is me. Firas says it poked a bunch of holes in the garden with thorns like ballista bolts. Elle says level 173 and most fun she's had all floor. Carl says go for the one fifteen miles west when my spell resets. I don't know if I can stomach that again, man.

beats.headline: 600 of them outside
beats.text: Level 42 now, almost double what I was when I met Carl. My blood bar's only half full from sitting in the guild, so I gotta get back out there with Firas and Britney. Then Samantha does this Hannibal thing with her tongue at me, man. So the map: if every hunter's at this party, that's like 600 of them outside the doors when it's over, and like a hundred of us. We'll get our asses kicked.

beats.headline: Nobody asked me not to
beats.text: Everybody's signing Carl's plan in the bathroom thing. Katia, Imani, Elle says Jesus Christ, Carl, you're going to get us all killed. Donut hates the paper. Florin wants Lucia Mar. I write that nobody has tried to convince me not to go down the stairs, and I think we should. Firas writes same.

beats.headline: The boombox
beats.text: Okay so, Donut made me do it. I built her a boombox out of Carl's trap modules so it's not so loud, and I'm hidden backstage doing the voice, like a monster truck rally. It's Mongo! Carl wants to know how many trap modules I used. Hang on a second, man, don't get madder. Two of his smoke bombs go off too. Then I can't figure out how to turn the music off, and he has to give me instructions over chat.

beats.headline: The Twister is taken
beats.text: I figured out the tunnels on the castle map. They're not ducts, they're how the queen's cat gets around, like the ones Jojo's grandma had, and one goes right into the security room. Tonight I'm on chat helping the Sledge fly the Twister, and the mantises take it. They're all onboard. The changelings turned to birds and left, and the Sledge had to jump. He says he's got the controller and can crash it into the turrets, like in GTA. Don't crash the Twister, man!

beats.headline: Reykjavik, and fifty YOOHOOs
beats.text: Okay, so, Reykjavik is actually snowy and icy, which is backwards from what I heard. I'm doing better. Britney's face hasn't healed, but she's been going out on her own and levelling really fast. Almost everybody from our bubble on the fifth floor died on the sixth. Langley and the car salesmen guys, Gwen, Firas. Also, Samantha. I put her in my chat, and she wrote YOOHOO like fifty times, and when I answered she asked me what I was wearing. Carl says mute her. In an hour Britney and I go on Dungeon Sidekicks.

beats.headline: Great. Just great.
beats.text: Donut messages me about Juice Box. My fiancée has gotten very scary, she says, so I had better tell her she's pretty every day and never eat potato chips in bed. So, okay. She really ripped the guy's head off? Donut says it was very bloody and gross, and that she did it dressed like that elf guy's mom, and it made him scream a lot. Great. Just great. Afterwards I'm at the big table in the Desperado Club with everybody, and I don't say much.

beats.headline: An achievement for a bucket
beats.text: So I'm holding the bucket. Katia's puking, like, every colour, and it keeps getting fuller and I don't know where it's all coming from, man. The waitress ignores me when I ask for another one. Then the croc guards won't let me take it into the bathroom. So I stick it in my inventory. And I get an achievement for storing a bucket of vomit.

beats.headline: Christmas on the island
beats.text: Okay so, it's Christmas Eve down here, man, and I want to know if we're all getting together once midnight passes. Carl says it isn't really Christmas, it's like early March or something. Oh man, really? It feels like we've been here a year. Donut says Carl hadn't even put his tree away when everything happened. Still, we should do something. Maybe we could give each other presents. Imani says let's make sure we all get our keys first.

beats.headline: Tonight it's Christmas
beats.text: Okay so, Carl walks in and says it's inappropriate, and for once I don't laugh. My best friend died. Imani's squad doesn't have a key, Tserendolgor doesn't have a key, and we all know what happens next. I've got a whole army of elves waiting to kill me on the ninth floor. Britney can't stop crying. So no, man. Tonight it's Christmas, and we're drinking eggnog. He looks at me, pulls a turkey out of his inventory, and says it isn't Christmas until we eat one.

beats.headline: Five skulls, and nearly the whole gang
beats.text: Okay so, Samantha hits me like a thrown football, and there goes all my air. Then Mongo nearly bowls over Britney, so that's everybody saying hi. Man, it's too bad Florin already went down the stairs, or it'd be the whole gang. I've got five player killer skulls over my head now, all from one attack. They look wrong up there. And this place really sucks, no joke. Carl wants to know how we got here, and Li Jun tells him it was Lucia Mar.

beats.headline: Sorry, cat lady
beats.text: Carl opens the door and the nun is right there, running at us screaming "Sinner!", and he zaps her with a wand and she just drops and slides up to his feet. I think I just crapped myself, no joke. Somebody has to finish it. I've already got five skulls and none of these guys have any, so I push past Carl and say sorry, cat lady, I never met you, and I put the dagger in. Then there's a spinning squiggle over my head, like a little tornado, and music starts. Uh-oh.

beats.headline: A box for outliving her
beats.text: Dude. Okay so, everyone's in the chat yelling, and the decks are still out because demons are everywhere, and I just got a Celestial box. For outliving a goddess. One who put a marked-for-death curse on me. No joke. Then Donut tells everybody to stop talking, because nobody can find Carl.

beats.headline: Firas's name for it
beats.text: My celestial box gives me an Airship Portal, which is an elevator up to a hangar, and a ship. Katia says it's not an airplane, more like a drone thing, a tilt rotor. It runs on a soul crystal, like the Twister. I named it Party Planner, 'cause that's what Firas wanted to call the Twister, and I told him it was stupid. It's a bomber, too. The System calls the model Casket in the Sky. Carl says it looks like a death trap. Katia said that too, especially after she read the description.

beats.headline: Game of Thrones stuff
beats.text: She's messaging me non-stop about getting married so our houses are bonded. It's all Game of Thrones stuff, man. Out loud she's all confident, but in the messages she's different. I think she's really scared, in over her head. Carl says I don't have to. I already told her I would. If the NPCs turn on us, we're screwed. So I stand up, take her hand, and say we should get married right away. Donut makes me say I love you. Then she makes me say it twice.

beats.headline: I wish my mom was here
beats.text: Changeling weddings come in two parts, which is kind of a relief. The small one is now, in the grimy entrance bar: no rings, no officiant, no singing, and Donut is mad about all three. Juice Box goes to her blank form and we hold hands. I catch Carl staring and tell him I wish my mom was here. Then we whisper vows we made up on the spot, in each other's ears. We'll say them out loud at the Confirmation, in about a month. And that's it. We're married.

beats.headline: The bombing run
beats.text: Okay so, we see the target. Lowering for the bombing run. Not too low, Carl says. In and out, into the fog. The bombs don't go on their trench, man, they go in a straight line right in front of it, to leave a crater, shower the guys inside with dirt and clear the traps out there. Holy shit, that was scary. I got hit with a few spells, but the shields held. Circling round to the rendezvous.

beats.headline: Grounded under the roof
beats.text: Okay so, we finished the repair from the inside, but the portal has to be fixed by hand from outside, or the whole hangar stays grounded. The door to it is on top of the castle, man. Anybody who goes up there is a prime target. So we stay grounded.

beats.headline: They showed me a video
beats.text: Okay so, Victory and Drick have me in the privacy bubble for the live update, and then they show me a video of me and Juice Box together. I was having her do Erza, and, man, it's great when you're doing it, but watching it back is something else. I come out a little freaked out. Carl says get to Area 52, make sure everything's properly loaded, keep in contact with Donut, low and fast, in and out. Then he says change of plans, hang out, we'll talk. No, no, you're right. I gotta get to work.

beats.headline: Bombs away over King's Point
beats.text: Okay so, Britney says the Semeru are waiting on my run. Heigh ho, silver. Every bomb on board arms itself, Carl makes them extra, and I dump the whole load in seconds, the square No Disassembles and then the Waffle Makers. Shields crack like eggs. A green death ray misses us by a hundred feet and hits the ceiling of the floor. You missed, man. Then the dwarves agitate the lava tubes, and the orcs threw a backup shield over the mountain, and the top of it blows, and we are way too close.

beats.headline: Tell Katia I'm sorry
beats.text: Okay so, I'm going down. Feather falling. I hit the dragon with the missiles and it just got pissed and ripped Party Planner in half, and the bombs fell out before they were armed. I think my door gunners are dead. Glad Bonnie and Skarn weren't here. That cop's husband was right, man. Tell Katia when she wakes up I'm sorry to be such a fuckup. I sent Juice Box a message, but she's still in that meeting. Reaver security is tracking me. I'm landing right in the middle of their castle.

beats.headline: Gills, man
beats.text: Okay so, I wake up coughing, and water comes out of my neck. Gills, man. Where am I? Mordecai tells me to switch off the water-breathing notification. I did already, when I woke up. But something's wrong. I feel weird. Everybody claps anyway. Then Samantha zips up, says we're cousins now, and kisses me on the lips. And Mongo spits a chewed-up plastic heart and lungs onto the floor of the tent.

beats.headline: Divorce papers
beats.text: Juice Box left me. She gave me divorce papers. Donut tells me to get in the stairwell. No way, man. I gotta say goodbye to Katia. Then Katia wakes up, and the goddess says the father has to be human, and Katia asks if I'd be willing. Am I still human? I touch my neck. The goddess says of course, and a good soul at that. Then sure, I guess. If she'll have me. It'll be a boy. Spoilers.

beats.headline: The lowrider
beats.text: Okay so, our truck is an older Tahoe, which sounds fine, except it's a neon lowrider with like two inches of clearance, so we kept bottoming out. There's a hydraulic system. I didn't know how it worked. Britney says I drive like an American. We came in second-to-last, and we'd have lost if the tentacle guys hadn't gotten eaten, so the audience picked our upgrade, and they picked wheel spinners. They light up the road. It does have a great sound system, though. Tran's stuck in his garage with a hearse and some wrecked spider legs.

beats.headline: Last again, and still no tires
beats.text: Okay so, we made it, man. Me, Britney, Bautista. Last of the survivors again, which means the audience votes our upgrade again. Our replacement team was more NPCs and we took them out right at the start, no joke. Still no proper tires, though, which is kind of the whole thing with a race. Next track's called Satan's Water Park, and Prepotente's team is on it with us. Honestly? Could be worse.

beats.headline: First place, for once
beats.text: Okay so, we're in first place in our heat. For once. Prepotente's in first first. Before the race Bodi went into Hungry Eyes alone and ate, like, a thousand things, and his buffs make Eileen go really fast. Eileen's our lowrider. I didn't name her. Our track is waterslide tubes, and there's this Satan guy who keeps hoping none of the tubes lead to his butthole. Sweety loves the tubes. Also, the bat dudes are selling acid rain protection. Get it before it's gone.

beats.headline: A gecko in the garage
beats.text: Okay so, we won a key, and I used it, and now there's a gecko in my garage. Like a whole second ride. I did what Carl said and checked for the hidden room in the house, and there was an engineer in there, which is, no joke, a great find. There were also mobs in the house. Nobody mentioned the mobs. Be careful if you're doing it, man. Anyway. Pretty sweet.

beats.headline: Like trading a Pokémon
beats.text: Okay so the plan is basically Li Na goes in a pet carrier, the robot sucks up the pet carrier, the robot gets sold, and some guy on the other side opens it. It's like trading a Pokémon between devices, man. Donut was not into that comparison. Also I named the robot. Suckira, after my mom's vacuum in Florida. It was a fair coin flip, no matter what Samantha says. She says she cheated for me, because that's what a woman does for her man. Please stop sticking your tongue in my gills.

beats.headline: An upgrade thief
beats.text: Dude, that sucked. We came in last place again, but we made it, and we got this awesome engineer lady. She's an upgrade thief. She takes upgrades off somebody else's car and puts them on yours, which, no joke, is the best job. A ton of people didn't make it, man. But Britney ripped the head off one of the skeleton-astronaut things with her bare hands, so, you know. Some good news.

beats.headline: Go check up on my kid
beats.text: Okay so, Bautista's heading out with the Cabaret group, maybe to India after, and I'm handing out cookies, and I tell him, hey, you can go check up on my kid. Which, yeah. Wrong thing to say, man. Donut sucks in a breath and Carl messages me that it was the wrong thing to say. Bautista just looks at me for a long time. Then he grins, pats my arm, calls me brother, and says he'll check on the child I'm having with his girlfriend. So we're good.

beats.headline: My mom's apartment
beats.text: This is bull, man. My mom doesn't even live in an apartment. But her stuff is here, and she's a giant, and the name over her head says Lady Bird, which is her name, and also says shell. There's a picture of me on the wall graduating college, which I never did, and I'm way thinner. Then I see me. Actual me, walking around, in, like, good shape, and no X over my eyes. Dude. This is bizarre.

beats.headline: You're never going to see me again
beats.text: Samantha's zipping around my head, blowing into my gills, saying she's going to tea-bag me, and she only just asked what that means, man. So I tell her the thing I've been not telling her. Stop. I'm leaving. You're never going to see me again. Then Chris goes through the portal, and Britney jumps in right after him, and I'm next, and she's crying on my arm, and I don't really know what to do with that.

beats.headline: Out through Imani's portal
beats.text: Racing floor. Some of us drew heats with other crawlers in them, which is the bad kind of heat, and Carl's got a plan for it, because of course he does. Imani has the portal open again. So me and everybody else from the mixed heats are going through it. Not my portal. It's never my portal. I've been walking through other people's doors since the fifth floor and, honestly, no complaints.

beats.headline: Entering Sheol
beats.text: Okay so, that was not the Pineapple Cabaret. I stepped into the storage and for a nanosecond, or years, man, I dreamed about my mom telling me I'm rotting. Then: Entering Sheol. The fifteenth floor. You can't skip floors, everybody knows that. It's hot. Britney's here with her pickaxe, and Pontiff, and a little red demon called Forkith puts a leech on me so I don't die. Chris is being held down. Werewolf, apparently. Soldiers, the demon says.
